articles.summary: Victoria-based marine wildlife experience enters next chapter of growth with continued local leadership, conservation focus and commitment to regenerative tourism Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced it has acquired Eagle Wing Tours, a Victoria, British Columbia-based whale watching and marine wildlife experience, expanding its portfolio into one of Canada's most visited and resilient tourism destinations and advancing its strategy of investing in iconic experiences in markets with strong long-term demand. The acquisition marks Pursuit's entry into the Vancouver Island market, a globally recognized destination known for its marine wildlife, natural beauty, vibrant communities and year-round visitor appeal. Victoria welcomes nearly five million visitors annually, highlighting the strength of the region’s visitor economy. articles.summary: Conference Call to be Held at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on August 5, 2026 Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit” or the “company”) (NYSE: PRSU), announced today that it plans to release financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 after market close on Wednesday, August 5, 2026 and will host a conference call at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on the same day to review its financial results and provide business updates. A live audio webcast of the call will be available in listen-only mode through the "Events Presentations" section of Pursuit’s website, where the company will also post its earnings press release and an earnings presentation prior to the call. The live call can also be accessed by dialing (888) 500-3691 or (646) 307-1951 and entering the access code 71058. To avoid wait time and bypass speaking with an operator to join the call, participants can pre-register using the following registration link: https://registrations.events/direct/Q4I71058VIPKaLDJvn2J0t08E
articles.title: Pursuit Announces Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call

articles.summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit”) (NYSE: PRSU) today announced that it has completed the sale of its Flyover flying theater attraction business (“Flyover”) to Brogent Technologies Inc. for $75 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, representing a multiple of approximately 14.5 times Flyover’s 2025 Adjusted EBITDA contribution. articles.title: Pursuit Completes Strategic Divestiture of Flyover Business, Strengthening Focus on Growth in Iconic Destinations
